$comment: Documented, EXPIRING exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs (ported from
molecule 2026-10-03 after the same bare-audit wall). Every advisory still
fails CI unless it is listed here by its GHSA id and unexpired. An entry is a
risk decision with a date on it, not a mute button: when expires passes the
gate goes red again so the decision gets remade. Never add an entry to make a
build green — add it only when there is no upstream fix AND the exposure is

accepted.reason: AbortSignal cancellation bypass: a walk keeps traversing after its signal aborts (advisory published 2026-10-30T23:09Z). Fixed only in glob 14.0.2+, a major released 2026-10-27. Re-checked 2026-11-15: the only consumer left in this lockfile is workbox-build 7.4.1 (^11.0.1), reached through the vite-plugin-pwa devDependency; both are latest (vite-plugin-pwa 2.0.0 still declares workbox-build ^7.4.1), so there is no release on glob 14. The @molecule/api-database-postgresql chain is gone from this tree. UNREACHABLE AS USED: the defect needs a caller that passes an AbortSignal to bound a walk; workbox-build calls globSync(globPattern, { cwd, follow, ignore }) (build/lib/get-file-details.js, re-verified in the installed 7.4.1 on 2026-11-15) at app BUILD time with the build config file lists, and the published mlcl package carries none of it. Residual risk: a workbox-build release that starts bounding a walk with a signal. Re-check at expiry for a workbox-build release on glob 14, bump, and drop this entry.

accepted.package: minimatch 10 (via ts-morph -> @ts-morph/common, glob 11 above; dev: typescript-eslint -> @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree)
accepted.reason: DoS through globparts amplification of a crafted PATTERN (advisory published 2026-10-30T23:09Z). Fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1+, a major released 2026-10-27 that removes makeRe() and Minimatch#regexp. Re-checked 2026-11-15: @oclif/core 5.1.12 (with plugin-help 7, oclif 6, @oclif/test 5) and eslint 10.15.0 with @eslint/config-array 0.23.6 were bumped and are on minimatch 11.0.8. The remaining consumers have no release that accepts 11 (all latest on 2026-11-15): @ts-morph/common 0.29.0 ^10.0.1 (ts-morph 28.0.0 pins ~0.29.0), @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.72.2 ^10.2.2, glob 11.1.0 ^10.1.1 (workbox-build, entry above). An overrides pin to 11 would break ts-morph, which calls makeRe() and reads .regexp. MITIGATED BY REACHABILITY: the attacker must control the pattern. The one runtime consumer is ts-morph, and mlcl gives it a single pattern, its own constant source glob (src/lib/api-extractor.ts: <package src>/**/*.{ts,tsx}, the only addSourceFilesAtPaths call, re-verified 2026-11-15); no pattern comes from a network request or another user. typescript-estree matches this repo own lint config globs, and glob 11 is build-time tooling above. Residual risk: a future command that passes untrusted input as a glob pattern. Re-check at expiry for consumer releases on minimatch 11, bump, and drop this entry.

accepted.package: picomatch (via oclif command discovery, ts-morph, and development tooling)
accepted.reason: The advisory covers every published picomatch version through 4.0.7. On 2026-11-18 npm still ended at 4.0.7 and GitHub listed no patched release. The locked versions are 2.3.2, 4.0.5 and 4.0.7. The denial of service requires an untrusted glob pattern. Oclif gets its command-discovery globs from installed plugin configuration or its defaults. Documentation extraction uses the CLI's source-file glob under the local package directory. Development tools use repository configuration for patterns. Local plugin configuration and package paths containing glob syntax can still introduce a pattern. At expiry, check npm view picomatch versions --json and the advisory for a supported fixed release on each dependency range, update the lockfile, and remove this exception once node scripts/audit-gate.mjs passes without it.
